name: sales-enablement
description: Coaching and practice for sellers. Coach a sales call with a quote behind every score; quiz reps on your own pricing or product notes; rehearse with a practice buyer who reveals facts only when asked the right question; plan a demo where each scene answers a pain the buyer named; find buyer questions your team answers differently, without proof or not at all; and work out how long a new seller needs before selling alone, against your coaching hours. Uses only your material: no outside benchmarks, nothing invented. Does not rank or rate sellers.

interface.longDescription: Five skills for whoever gets sellers ready. Call coaching reads one to five transcripts and tells the seller what to say differently at the moments that mattered, with a quote from the call behind every score, talk share and question counts, and one drill. Rep certification writes a quiz from your own pricing or product notes, with an answer key that points to the line it came from and a list of questions your notes cannot answer, and plays a fictional buyer who reveals facts only when the rep asks the right question. Demo runbook plans one scene per pain the buyer named, with what not to show and a time check, or checks a script you have. Question bank finds the buyer questions your sellers answer differently, without proof or not at all, and proposes one answer from your material. Ramp plan works out how many weeks a new seller needs before selling alone from your sales cycle, and whether the coach's hours cover it. Scores are practice feedback for the person coached, never input to hiring, pay or dismissal; the kit does not rank, compare or monitor sellers. No outside benchmarks and nothing invented.
defaultPrompt: 30-min demo for a VP Support. Pains: first reply takes 9 hours, no weekend cover. We have AI triage, shared inbox, reports.
Make a 10-question rep quiz with answer key from these rules: Pro $40/seat, min 10 seats, annual only, max discount 15%.
Role-play a skeptical CFO at a 200-person logistics firm. I sell route-planning software. Score me when I say stop.
